pass_rule: b <= f: no conflicting honest commits and every honest validator commits every height; conflicting proofs share >= f + 1 signers, all compromised when from the same round; no honest validator accused; b = f + 1 at p = 0: conflicts happen
known_issues: votes are sent once, not gossiped: a double signer is caught only when one honest validator sees both of its votes, in practice when a commit proof reaches the other half by catch-up. When the split makes the round fail without any commit (n = 7, b = 1: neither half reaches Q), nobody sees both votes; CometBFT's vote gossip would show them (column caught)

beyond f, the attacker keeps splitting after a fork: the honest half whose chain the compromised validators did not follow can never reach Q again (undecided heights); that is the expected loss of liveness beyond f, not a bug
conflicting proofs from different rounds share >= f + 1 signers, but naming the culprits then needs the votes of the rounds in between (locking), not just the two proofs
